description: Battery Lab (pages/5_Battery_Lab.py), Finland: day-ahead arbitrage co-optimised with FCR-N and FCR-D up/down as a daily linear program (src/model/revenue_stacking.py), settled against realised Fingrid reserve prices.
units: thousand EUR per MW per year (annualised), gross revenue unless the key says net; cycles_per_day are day-ahead cycles
run: yearly_perfect_foresight_ceiling: checks/test_revenue_stacking.py, run 2026-10-23 and re-run 2026-10-29 with identical output (it uses the actual day-ahead price, not the forecast). test_window_2026: checks/test_battery_lab_data.py --write, run 2026-10-29 on the served FI forecast of the models trained that day and re-run 2026-10-30 after the per-hour sorting of the quantile bands, with identical output (Python 3.11.5, versions in requirements.txt)
method: Daily linear program in src/model/revenue_stacking.py. The round-trip efficiency is applied once: the square root of the round-trip efficiency on charge and on discharge in the state-of-charge balance, and day-ahead discharge settled at price times energy sold. Charge plus discharge is at most the power rating in every hour. Figures published before 2026-10-23 applied the round-trip efficiency a second time to the day-ahead leg and understated day-ahead revenue.

yearly_perfect_foresight_ceiling.source: written by checks/test_revenue_stacking.py --write (yearly_stack_summary, mode oracle with the actual day-ahead price as forecast, so both day-ahead and reserve prices are known; 2026 covers January to May, annualised)
yearly_perfect_foresight_ceiling.battery: generic_fi_2h: Generic LFP 1 MW / 2 MWh, round-trip efficiency 0.88 (src/model/battery_specs.py)

test_window_2026.source: checks/test_battery_lab_data.py --write (stacking_backtest on the served FI test forecast from predict.served_predictions), both battery specs below

modes.oracle: perfect reserve foresight: reserve prices known in advance; day-ahead schedule from the model forecast
modes.causal: day-ahead schedule from the model forecast; reserve bids = same hour of the previous day times a bid margin, accepted only if at or below the realised clearing price
modes.da_only: day-ahead arbitrage on the model forecast, no reserves

generic_fi_2h.description: Generic LFP 2h battery (the dashboard default, shown in docs/img/battery_lab_fi.png)

sungrow_powertitan2_2h.description: Sungrow PowerTitan 2.0 (2h), datasheet values; the battery used by checks/test_battery_lab_data.py
